Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing Data Science & Analytics at Trainline👋    

Data Science & Analytics (DSA) is central to how we build products, delight our customers and grow our business. Our Data Scientists are embedded alongside Data Analysts in cross-functional teams which exist across product and marketing.  Data Scientists have a high degree of autonomy and are empowered to drive the success of their teams, using all data and techniques at their disposal.

Our autonomous model creates a huge opportunity for personal influence and impact - as the data scientist on the team you will be actively driving innovation on the team by contributing to strategy, execution and continuous learning.    

As a Data Scientist at Trainline, you will... 🚄    

As a Data Scientist in our New Business team, you'll help shape how Trainline grows beyond train tickets. From insurance and protection to hotels, car hire, attractions and other travel experiences, we're exploring new ways to add value throughout the customer journey, including making it easier for customers to plan more of their trip in one place. You'll use customer insights, experimentation and analytical techniques to uncover new opportunities, influence product strategy and create meaningful value for both our customers and Trainline.

- Contribute to simple, seamless customer journeys by identifying where we can remove barriers and add value

title: Amazon Image Brief & Conversion Associate
description:
Amazon images are where most listings win or lose. The main image decides whether anyone clicks. The six behind it decide whether they buy - and whether the parcel comes back.
We are hiring one person to own that. Take a live listing, work out from its reviews and returns why it is not converting, and write the image brief that fixes it - a brief a remote designer can execute without a single follow-up question.
This is an operational and analytical role, not a design role. You will not be making the artwork. You decide what it has to say, in what order, and you hold the returned files to that standard.
The split is 75 / 25.

•
75% - the briefs. The conversion thinking, the ranked USPs, the seven slots, the QA of what comes back.

•
25% - analysis and reporting. Part of it is the work that feeds the brief: pulling the reviews, reading them properly, turning them into a persona and a pain-point list. The rest is the follow-up reporting we owe clients - sales and traffic, return reasons, and what actually moved once new images went live.

You will work across markets. Mostly European and US listings, across many markets and languages, in categories you have never shopped in yourself.
What you will do
Image briefs and conversion thinking - 75% of the role

• Diagnose why a listing is not converting: what the gallery fails to answer, which objection nobody addressed, where the buyer loses confidence and leaves.

• Know what each slot is for. The main image earns the click. Images two to seven answer objections in the order a buyer actually raises them. The size and fit slots decide whether the sale stays sold.

• Rank seven USPs by what wins the click and what prevents a return. They are not the same list, and the order is the decision.

• Write the brief for each slot in our template: one message per slot, one headline, an optional subline, a maximum of three to four callouts, every line adding something new.

• Apply the two-second rule. One idea per image, legible at thumbnail size on a phone. If a slot needs a paragraph to work, it is not a slot.

• Work inside the client’s brand book - colours, fonts, existing assets - naming exactly which asset to reuse and where the file lives.

• Keep sizing accurate and internally consistent: backend size chart against image size chart, US against EU conventions.

• Know Amazon image policy cold: main-image rules, no price, ratings, review counts or badges, and how the gallery renders on a phone.

• QA the returned files against the brief and say precisely why something is not working - hierarchy, contrast, whitespace, text density, whether a close-up box earns its place.

The analysis behind the briefs - part of the 25%

• Download the reviews yourself and read them properly: themes, frequency, and the exact words customers use.

• Pull Voice of the Customer and the return report, and weight return reasons against units actually sold.

• Turn that into a buyer persona and a ranked pain-point list - for categories you did not grow up in.

• Separate “we can fix this on the listing” from “the product is the problem”.

• Evidence only. Never invent a return reason, a measurement or a number, and ask when something is missing.

Reporting that follows up sales - the rest of the 25%

• Find and download the right reports without being walked through it: Sales & Traffic, Search Query Performance, Returns, Voice of the Customer.

• Build the recurring follow-ups: sales and traffic trend, return rate by size, conversion before and after an image update.

• Merge two exports on ASIN or SKU and produce a clean pivot, without hand-counting rows.

• Deliver a one-page summary that says what matters, why it matters and what to do about it. Not a data dump.

Making the workflow better with AI - across all of the above

• Use Claude and ChatGPT as part of the work, not as a novelty: review analysis, first-draft copy, translation, summarising exports.

• Work inside our Claude projects, with the context

title: IT Tech Support Specialist
description:
Colure Health builds technology that amplifies the impact of real clinicians. Our care platform blends intelligent automation with compassionate workflows, helping physicians stay connected to their patients and deliver better outcomes with less friction. We believe innovation should serve people, and we’re committed to creating tools that empower every provider to improve the health, experience, and quality of life of the communities they serve.

POSITION SUMMARY

The IT Technical Support Specialist keeps Colure Health ’s people productive and secure. This role is the first point of contact for technology issues across the executive team, US staff and the international care team in the Philippines, Ecuador and Colombia. It manages devices, accounts and everyday systems, and applies the security controls that protect patient data. As Colure adds clinics and staff, this role will help build repeatable onboarding, offboarding and support processes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

End-User Support

• Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 support by ticket, chat, phone and remote session for hardware, software, accounts, VoIP and connectivity.

• Troubleshoot issues affecting care coordinators and enrollment staff, including softphones, headsets, CRM and platform access, and home-network problems, often across time zones.

• Document resolutions and maintain the knowledge base and self-help guides.

Accounts and Access

• Provision and deprovision user accounts, email, licenses and application access, in coordination with HR and in line with least-privilege principles.

• Complete same-day access removal at offboarding and support periodic access reviews.

• Administer password resets, MFA enrollment and single sign-on support.

Devices and Assets

• Configure, enroll and maintain laptops and mobile devices in mobile device management (MDM), with encryption, screen lock and endpoint protection enforced.

• Maintain the hardware and software asset inventory, including shipping, retrieval and secure wiping of devices.

• Apply patches and updates, and track compliance with device security standards.

Systems and Security Support

• Administer productivity and collaboration tools, such as Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, the phone system and video conferencing.

• Support the Cybersecurity Specialist with phishing reports, alert triage, and evidence collection for audits.

• Set up technology for new clinic locations, including workstations, printers, networking and peripherals, with vendor coordination as needed.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 2+ years of IT help desk or desktop support experience.

• Hands-on experience with Windows and macOS, Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, and an MDM platform such as Intune, Jamf or Kandji.

• Comfortable supporting remote users, including some international users, by phone, chat and remote-access tools.

• Understanding of basic networking (DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, VPN) and of security practices such as MFA and encryption.

• Clear, patient communication and strong documentation habits.

• Ability to work a schedule that covers part of US Eastern Time business hours, with occasional after-hours support.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• CompTIA A+, Network+ or Security+, or Google IT Support certification.

• Experience in a healthcare or other HIPAA-regulated environment.

• Experience with ticketing systems such as Jira Service Management, Freshservice or Zendesk.

• Experience with VoIP and contact-center platforms.

• Conversational Spanish, to support team members in Ecuador and Colombia.

MEASURES OF SUCCESS

Within 90 days: documented onboarding and offboarding checklists and an accurate device inventory.

•
Ongoing: first-response and resolution times within agreed service levels, and same-day access removal for every departing workforce member.

• Collaborating seamlessly: lead through influence across collectives, building deep partnerships with engineering, design, data, fincrime, legal and marketing to resolve complex organisational trade-offs.

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply- even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

- Manage the accounts receivable process

- Support payroll and people costs together with our payroll providers

- Experience with fast-growing startups or SaaS companies, where you wore several hats and thrived

Founded in Sweden in 2019, Validio is trusted by data-driven enterprises like Nordea, Canva, and Truecaller. description:
About the Role: We are seeking an experienced Senior Factoring Underwriter & Credit Specialist with direct, hands-on expertise in accounts receivable (A/R) factoring. In this role, you will lead the credit evaluation, risk structuring, and day-to-day portfolio oversight of invoice factoring facilities for high-growth e-commerce, CPG, and B2B wholesale businesses.

This role is specifically tailored for an expert who understands the operational, legal, and credit nuances of invoice factoring. Beyond analyzing classic financial statements, you will evaluate debtor creditworthiness, verify invoice authenticity, establish debtor credit limits, manage dilution risk, and ensure proper perfection of security interests (comprehensive UCC lien searches, UCC-1 filings, Notices of Assignment, and tri-party lockbox accounts). What You'll Do:

Factoring Credit Underwriting: Underwrite prospective client factoring facilities and establish credit limits on individual account debtors using credit agency reports (D&B, Experian, CreditSafe), payment trends, trade references, and financial statements.

UCC Search Analysis & Lien Perfection: Thoroughly read, interpret, and evaluate UCC lien searches, tax lien reports, and judgment filings; identify senior or conflicting security interests (blanket liens, inventory lenders, equipment PMSIs); and coordinate lien releases, terminations, subordination agreements, and intercreditor deeds to guarantee a first-priority position on factored accounts receivable.

•
Invoice Verification & Collateral Analysis: Review and verify invoices, purchase orders, bills of lading, and proof of delivery prior to funding; assess debtor concentration, aging trends, and customer dispute risk.

Dilution & Reserve Management: Model and monitor dilution factors (chargebacks, trade discounts, returns, co-op advertising offsets) to set appropriate advance rates and reserve holdbacks.

Legal & Perfection Controls: Oversee UCC-1 financing statement filings, continuous lien maintenance (amendments/continuations), Notice of Assignment (NOA) deliveries, and lockbox/account control agreements (DACA).

•
Portfolio & Debtor Monitoring: Track ongoing portfolio collections, remittance trends, daily lockbox reconciliations, aged accounts receivable, unapplied cash, and early warning signs of borrower or debtor distress.

•
Product Collaboration: Partner directly with Product, Engineering, and Risk Operations teams to translate manual factoring operations, lien checking, and verification logic into scalable, automated fintech software features.

•
AI-Driven Efficiency: Leverage AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) to accelerate credit memo generation, extract data from complex debtor agreements, and streamline verification audit trails.

What You’ll Need:

•
Direct Factoring Experience (Mandatory): Minimum of 3+ years of direct, hands-on commercial accounts receivable (A/R) factoring underwriting experience (recourse or non-recourse) within a commercial finance company, factoring house, bank factoring division, or specialized fintech. (Note: Standalone MCA, revenue-based financing, or general unsecured lending experience will not satisfy this requirement.)

UCC Lien Analysis & Perfection Expertise: Proven ability to read and interpret complex UCC lien search reports, identifying prior blanket liens, purchase money security interests (PMSIs), tax liens, and active encumbrances to structure lien releases, subordination agreements, and intercreditor deeds under UCC Article 9.

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

- You've administered a multi-entity NetSuite OneWorld instance yourself, including SuiteScript

title: Head of Video (all genders)

The role

As Head of Video, Berlin, you will shape how HelloFresh makes video for our international markets: the paid social engine, organic social, and our long-form YouTube content. Building and managing the team and systems behind all of it. You will lead the Berlin video team, including our international XPod, our fast and experimental content engine. Paid social is our biggest growth lever and the largest part of this role, but we do not want to lose the rest. Organic, long-form and brand storytelling all matter, and a strong Head of Video makes them work together. Whilst the scope is on our International market, we actively seek greater global collaboration. 

HelloFresh is at a pivotal moment of transformation. We are moving towards a modular, global content system, bringing AI-assisted workflows into how we plan, shoot and edit, and balancing centralised brand standards with local market needs. Berlin makes content for up to 14 markets that each need localisation, translation and cultural care, with local market teams who have a say on what ships. Our international XPod is a younger team than its New York counterpart, and part of your job is to bring it to the same standard, cadence and strategy.

You will need to be as comfortable discussing channel metrics, spend and creative testing as you are discussing a script or a shot. You will partner closely with the Growth, Creative Strategy and Brand teams, with the XPod Director in North America, and with our Photo, AI, Culinary and Studio Operations teams, and you will have a real voice in how video works across the whole group.

What you’ll do

Studio Leadership & People

A strong video team is how we keep creative capability and institutional knowledge through a period of rapid change. You will lead, develop and inspire the Berlin video team, across XPod, organic social and long-form.

• Set clear performance expectations, agree individual growth plans, and keep a healthy performance culture through regular 1:1s and honest, timely feedback.

• Build and develop a team that spans producers, editors, creative strategists and post-production, and create career paths that keep talent with us.

• Hire well, onboard well and keep the standard high as the team grows, including moving roles from freelance to full-time where it makes sense.

• Create an open, supportive team culture where concerns are raised early and good ideas can come from anyone.

Paid Social & Performance

Paid social is where we see the strongest return for the business. You will make international XPod a fast, reactive and experimental performance engine.

• Deliver paid social content that performs, to brief, prioritised with the Growth and channel teams.

• Run a clear test-and-learn rhythm across hooks, formats, creators and channels, and use performance data, including spend and cost per result, to decide what to make next.

• Attend regular Growth meetings to align on performance, localisation, trends and channel spend, and turn what you learn into briefs and shoot plans quickly.

• Build a lean creative strategy function inside the team that works hand in hand with Growth and Brand.

• Bring Berlin XPod up to the cadence, tooling and strategy of our most mature XPod team, and share one way of working.

Organic & Long-Form YouTube

We want to keep investing in organic and long-form content alongside paid. Both build the brand and feed the paid engine.

• Own the organic social video plan and grow it with the right talent, cadence and measures.

• Lead our long-form YouTube content, currently focused on the UK, and develop it into a global proposition where the audience and the budget support it.

• Make sure every long-form and organic shoot creates cut-downs, hooks and pickup shots that can serve paid, search and YouTube campaigns.

• Keep the quality and storytelling of our brand video high, from short-form to long-form.

Localisation & Modular Content

title: Head of Pricing & Packaging
description:
ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement - built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

YOUR ROLE

Pricing is one of the biggest levers Zip has to capture the value we create for customers, and today it is shared across Product, Deal Strategy/Ops, and Product Marketing. As Zip's first Head of Pricing & Packaging, you will own pricing and packaging as one function, with a single strategy, a single set of rules, and a single process for getting new products to the field.

- You own the whole function: strategy, packaging, governance, and the operating rhythm. There is no existing team, playbook, or system to inherit.

- You are both the strategist and the doer. You will build the models, run the research, write the policies, and make the call, then defend it in front of founders and the executive team.

- You will work through Product, Product Marketing, Deal Strategy/Ops, Sales, Finance, and Legal without formal authority over any of them.

- Headcount will be earned. You will decide what the function needs, size it, and make the business case for it. Expect to start as a team of one.

YOU WILL

PRICING STRATEGY AND PACKAGING

- Own pricing strategy across Zip's portfolio, including new product and module pricing, packaging tiers, and bundling.

- Run willingness-to-pay and competitive research (conjoint, Van Westendorp, benchmarking) and turn it into clear recommendations grounded in customer value.

- Design packaging that is simple for buyers to understand and leaves room for expansion.

- Chair a cross-functional pricing council that aligns Product, Sales, Finance, and Marketing and drives decisions to resolution.

- Build and own a new product introduction (NPI) process that carries the product roadmap through to field readiness.

PRICING OPERATIONS AND GOVERNANCE

- Stand up what doesn't exist today: discounting policy, approval workflows, exception governance, and deal desk guardrails, in partnership with the existing Deal Desk team.

- Define and report on pricing KPIs, including win rate by price point, discount leakage, price realization, and expansion ARR from packaging changes.

- Evaluate pricing and CPQ tooling with Deal Desk as Zip's needs mature.

LEADERSHIP

- Be the company's authority on monetization, bringing market and competitive pricing intelligence into executive and product planning.

- Present pricing recommendations and business cases to the founders and executive team.

- Build the case, roadmap, and hiring plan for a pricing team as the function matures.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 10+ years in pricing strategy, monetization, or revenue strategy, including 5+ years owning pricing and packaging at a B2B SaaS or technology company.

- Ownership of pricing and packaging for a multi-product or platform business: you made and defended the decisions, not only the analysis behind them.

- A track record of building or substantially standing up a pricing or commercial strategy function, with measurable results such as NRR improvement, ARR acceleration, or competitive win-rate gains.

- Experience influencing founders, C-suite, or board-level audiences, and aligning Product, Sales, Fina

title: Public Sector Account Executive
description:
VIDIZMO is growing its US sales team and looking for driven, experienced sales professionals to win and expand business with government, public safety, healthcare, legal, education and enterprise organizations. If you thrive in a fast-paced, AI-driven environment and want to move revenue rather than chase activity metrics, this is your seat.
VIDIZMO is an AI software company headquartered in Tysons, Virginia. We build Nexus, AI Intelligence Hub, AI Live Insight, and Redactor - a product family that lets organizations search, analyze, redact, and act on unstructured data, treating video, audio, images, documents, and text as equal first-class sources. More than 100 customers run VIDIZMO in production across public safety and justice, government, healthcare, financial services, education, legal, manufacturing, and energy, much of it on premises, air-gapped, or in FedRAMP High environments on a CJIS Security Policy-aligned architecture.
We're an independent software vendor: we build and support the platform, and a global network of channel partners sells, deploys, and supports it for their own clients - which is why the people we hire spend their time making partners and customers successful rather than running a direct sales funnel. VIDIZMO is an NVIDIA Inception partner and a Microsoft Solutions Partner for Data & AI, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified, and buyable through GSA, Carahsoft, and state/cooperative contract vehicles.
What you’ll do

• Own new business in your territory, from first conversation to signed contract.

• Run discovery and demos for our products: AI Intelligence Hub, Digital Evidence Management, Redactor, AI Live Insight and EnterpriseTube.

• Work with SDRs, partners and pre-sales engineers on deals with several decision-makers.

• Build relationships with IT, security, legal, operations and executive leaders.

• Keep pipeline and forecasts accurate in HubSpot.

What you bring

• 2+ years in a quota-carrying SaaS role: AE, account manager, or a senior SDR/BDR ready to close.

• Experience selling to enterprise, government, public safety, healthcare, legal or education organizations.

• Strong written and spoken English, and comfort presenting to senior buyers.

• A self-starter mindset in a remote, fast-moving team.

• A bachelor’s degree.

• Willingness to travel for meetings, demos, conferences, and partner activities.

• U.S. market experience.

• Authorization to work in the United States.

Why VIDIZMO

• Sell AI that solves real problems for agencies and enterprises.

• Remote, with travel for key meetings and events, and a team that backs you with pre-sales, partners and marketing.

• Room to grow as we expand our US sales team.

AI Tools Usage & Accountability
You're expected to use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to strengthen your outputs - but AI-generated work is never final without your review. You own accuracy, completeness, logic, compliance, and business alignment on every deliverable, regardless of the tools used to produce it.
Background & Security
Depending on territory and customer assignments, selected candidates may be required to complete employment and fingerprint-based background screening, CJIS security-awareness training, and confidentiality/security agreements, and to maintain eligibility to access government and law-enforcement facilities and Criminal Justice Information.
VIDIZMO is an equal-opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, performance, merit, and business requirements, without unlawful discrimination.

title: ML Runtime Engineer

Wanna join the adventure?
Loft's AI for Space group is building the stack that runs real machine learning in orbit; turning raw sensor data into decisions on the satellite itself, so insight reaches the customer in minutes instead of hours. The AI Engineering team is where models meet the spacecraft. We own the full path from a partner's trained model to something that actually runs - fast - on flight hardware: compiling ONNX models into optimized engines for each accelerator, the Space Inference Engine and its execution providers, the SDK that packages models for flight, and the perf tooling that proves a model fits its power, thermal, and latency budget before it ever leaves the ground. As our ML Runtime Engineer , you'll own model compilation and the performance tooling behind it. We're looking for someone scrappy - the kind of engineer who takes an unfamiliar model and an unforgiving power budget, digs into the graph, and gets it running on real hardware without waiting for the path to be handed to them. You'll move between model compilation, runtime internals, quantization, and hardware-in-the-loop CI, sometimes in the same afternoon. About this role:

Own model compilation: turn partner ONNX models into optimized engines per accelerator (TensorRT, Hailo, AMD/ROCm), within power & thermal budgets

Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. • Own the technical architecture and roadmap for Salesforce and the surrounding revenue tech stack, including Jira, Google Cloud, Heroku, Outreach, Marketo, and other internal business applications

• Partner with revenue leadership to gather and translate business requirements into scalable solutions, and to prioritize work against capacity and impact

description: Do you want to bring modern end-to-end encryption to people who rely on it every day? Then we're looking for you as a Rust Product Engineer - MLS (m/f/d) on our MLS team! We're bringing Messaging Layer Security (MLS, RFC 9420) to secure messaging for the German public sector. MLS defines the cryptographic core of group messaging and leaves delivery, ordering, identity and federation to whoever integrates it. That's the part we build: a Rust SDK, the server that orders and delivers MLS messages, and its integration with Matrix. Much of it has no off-the-shelf answer yet. We're also following the IETF's MIMI effort, which aims to let different messengers interoperate over MLS, and expect it to shape how our system federates. How we work: Small team, close collaboration. At Famedly the MLS team will be four to five engineers. We build the system together with a larger group of engineers at partner companies. Ownership in small groups. Day to day you work with two or three others on a project or a part of the system, and you own it from spec to operations. AI where it helps, people where it counts. We use coding agents a lot, for implementation, tests and exploring options. Protocol design, security-relevant decisions and the final review stay with people, and we keep adjusting where that line runs. Think first, then build. Architecture decision records, specs and written invariants keep both humans and agents on track, and we check our code against them. Your responsibilities: Turn requirements from our customer, the MLS standard and Matrix into specs and architecture decisions. title: Senior S&OP Manager
description:
At Rohlik, Integrated Business Planning and S&OP are not just planning routines-they are the backbone of how we run efficient operations, optimize resources, and scale sustainably.
We're looking for a Senior Sales and Operations Planning Manager who will work closely with our Supply Chain leadership and help build our end-to-end forecasting function from the ground up. This is a highly hands-on, builder role for someone who thrives on business partnering, deep-dive analytics, challenging manual processes, and turning raw data into decision-ready insights across all our European markets. To be clear on scope: this role owns the order- and revenue-level demand forecast that feeds the S&OP cycle - not SKU-level demand planning, which sits with the Supply Chain team.

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

- Build from the Ground Up: You won't just execute a process someone else built-you are one of the founding members of a brand-new department, giving you a direct hand in shaping the future of Supply Chain at Rohlik.

- Direct Business Impact: Your forecasts directly dictate inventory levels, labor scheduling, and delivery capacity across 5 countries and 12 fulfillment centers.

- Automation & Ownership: You have the autonomy and mandate to kill manual spreadsheets. If a process is repetitive, you get to spearhead its automation alongside our BI and Engineering teams.

- High-Growth E-Commerce Environment: Work in a fast-paced, high-velocity e-commerce and grocery ecosystem where data-driven decisions directly affect daily operations and customer satisfaction.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Demand Forecasting: Own the daily and weekly production of the group demand forecast (orders, SKU/order, and intraday shapes) across all markets, fulfillment centers, and planning horizons.

- Accuracy & Bias Ownership: Drive forecast accuracy and bias performance by market and horizon (target: 98% accuracy at order/revenue level); conduct deep-dive root-cause analyses on deviations and implement corrective actions.

- S&OP Core Analysis: Build and own the demand review pack and scenario models for the S&OP cycle, including quantified upside and downside cases.

- Operational Alignment: Translate agreed demand into actionable inventory, warehouse workload, labor, throughput, and delivery requirements for operating functions.

- Automation & Optimization: Proactively drive the automation of manual routines (e.g., mass-upload/locking for SKU edits, demand-chaser redesigns, automated AOV forecasting) instead of working around system gaps.

- Executive Decision Support: Prepare daily and weekly data, analysis, and options that feed into executive updates and S&OP governance rituals.

- Peaks & Campaigns: Lead forecasting prep for campaigns, seasonal transitions, and peak events, ensuring every manual adjustment is documented with clear assumptions and rationale.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with market planners, Category, Marketing, Fulfillment, Last Mile, and BI teams to collect quantified inputs on time and keep planning data trustworthy.

- Governance & Resilience: Actively identify and flag process gaps (single points of failure, missing notifications, undocumented calls) to make the department increasingly resilient over time.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required:

- 3+ years of experience in Demand Planning, Forecasting, Supply Chain Planning, or Business Analytics.

- Hands-on ownership of a recurring forecast within a high-velocity retail, e-commerce, logistics, or operational environment.

- Advanced command of forecasting methodologies, scenario modeling, and forecast accuracy metrics.

- Strong analytical stack: advanced spreadsheet modeling and SQL (or equivalent) to query large data sets independently.

- Ability to specify tooling improvements and drive automation alongside engineering/BI teams.

- Working knowledge of BI and visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar).

- Proven ability to enforce standards and deadlines across

We are looking for an exceptional Software Engineer to be an integral member of the Core Platform team. We work closely with traders and risk managers to provide real time and end of day Pricing and Risk information for all trading activity within QRT. This position has high visibility across the business and exposure to all parts of the trading lifecycle. This position requires a commitment to effective problem solving, strong technical skills, good attention to detail and excellent communication skills.

Your future role within QRT

The successful candidate will join the Production Management team based in New York / Houston, providing high-touch support to the QRT trading desks and Risk managers with a dedicated focus on Risk and PnL systems.

QRT trades across all major EMEA and US markets, and this role sits at the intersection of technology and front office operations. As a support engineer, you will be the primary point of contact for the investigation and resolution of issues impacting real-time risk monitoring, daily PnL figures, and trade / positions reconciliation. • Process improvement: Develop scripts and tools to automate reconciliation, monitoring, and alerting workflows to reduce manual effort and improve accuracy

• Release management: Support the deployment of risk system and PnL platform releases, validating output integrity before and after changes

• Evening/weekend support: Provide on-call coverage for critical end-of-day and start-of-day processes, normally via remote access

Qualifications

Essential

• Minimum 2 years in a risk, PnL, or quantitative support role within a trading firm, hedge fund, or investment bank

• Hands-on experience with PnL production workflows, including flash vs. official PnL reconciliation and attribution

Get rewarded for the hard ones. The role comes with highly competitive, performance-linked variable compensation.

Go where your target candidate is. If a complex search means you need to be in front of the right people somewhere else, you can travel to make it happen.

Grow past the desk. Over time, there's room to move into management and leadership alongside your own recruiting.

Sell something worth selling. We're growing massively year on year, and the money we move is a lifeline: remittances pay for school fees, medical bills, rent and food back home. That’s without even mentioning what the next phase of our growth looks like…
